headline: Indonesia Targets November 21 for Signing IEU-CEPA Trade Pact
summary: Indonesia aims to sign the Indonesia-European Union Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (IEU-CEPA) trade pact on November 21.
why: Bilateral and multilateral trade agreements can reduce tariffs, enhance market access, and stimulate cross-border commerce for participating emerging economies.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Trade pacts generally boost export opportunities and foreign investment for the participating nation.
